name: feature.recommendations.nodes
description: Recommendations feature node pack (MERCH-A chat-drivability) — read/author nodes over the ctx.features.recommendations surface. `resolve` returns ranked products for a funnel slot; `placement-upsert` authors a slot→source placement. BOTH are role:'action' (recorded → replay/:fork read the recorded output) because they operate over the MUTABLE recs co-occurrence cache + live catalog — a role:'read' node would re-execute and drift (ruling 7).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Recommendations Resolve
nodes.description: Resolves ranked products for a funnel slot (pdp/cart/post_purchase/…) over ctx.features.recommendations. role:'action' — output recorded for replay determinism (the recs cache is mutable). Inputs: orgId, slot, productId?, contactId?, sessionKey?.

nodes.label: Recommendations Placement Upsert
nodes.description: Authors a placement (slot → recommendation source, optional segment + holdout) over ctx.features.recommendations. role:'action', idempotent-by-effect. Inputs: orgId, slot, source, segmentId?, holdoutPct?.
